pains.label: Neck pain / stiffness
pains.description: Ache or stiffness in the neck, often with headaches or reduced turning range.

pains.label: Upper back / between the shoulder blades
pains.description: Burning or aching between the shoulder blades, worse late in the day or at a desk.

pains.label: Shoulder pain (cuff / impingement)
pains.description: Pain reaching overhead, behind the back, or lying on that shoulder.

pains.label: Elbow pain, outer side (tennis elbow)
pains.description: Pain on the outside of the elbow when gripping, lifting a cup, or opening a door.

pains.label: Elbow pain, inner side (golfer’s elbow)
pains.description: Pain on the inside of the elbow when curling, gripping hard, or hanging.

pains.label: Wrist / hand pain
pains.description: Pain bending the wrist back, taking weight on the hand, or gripping.

pains.label: Low back pain
pains.description: Ache or catch in the lower back, worse bending, sitting long, or lifting.

pains.label: Sciatica / nerve pain down the leg
pains.description: Pain, pins and needles or numbness travelling from the back into the buttock or leg.

pains.label: Hip pain / pinching in the groin-front
pains.description: Pinch at the front of the hip in a deep squat, or ache after sitting.

pains.label: Groin / inner-thigh pain
pains.description: Pain in the inner thigh when squeezing the legs together or stepping sideways.

pains.label: Hamstring pain / strain
pains.description: Pain at the back of the thigh or under the sit-bone when stretching or sprinting.

pains.label: Knee pain, front / kneecap
pains.description: Ache around or under the kneecap on stairs, deep squats, or long sitting.

pains.label: Knee pain, inner / outer / general
pains.description: Pain on the side of the knee, catching, or swelling after training.

pains.label: Achilles / calf pain
pains.description: Pain in the calf or just above the heel when pushing off or rising on the toes.

pains.label: Ankle pain / old sprain
pains.description: Pain, stiffness or giving-way at the ankle, worse on uneven ground.

pains.label: Shin pain / shin splints
pains.description: Ache along the front of the shin bone during or after walking, running or jumping.

pains.label: Heel / arch pain (plantar)
pains.description: Sharp heel or arch pain on the first steps of the morning or after standing.

pains.label: Abdominal wall / hernia / post-op core
pains.description: Bulge, pulling or pain in the abdominal wall when straining, coughing or lifting.

loadTags.AXIAL: Axial spinal compression - bar on back or front rack, loaded standing, carries
loadTags.LUM_HINGE: Loaded hip hinge / bent-over torso - lumbar shear
loadTags.LUM_FLEX: Loaded lumbar flexion - crunch, sit-up, leg raise, rounded pull
loadTags.LUM_EXT: End-range lumbar extension - back extension, hyper, superman, hip thrust
loadTags.NECK_COMP: Cervical compression - bar on traps, shrugs, overhead, head-on-bench
loadTags.SH_IMPINGE: Impingement-provocative arc - raises, upright row, behind-neck
loadTags.PEC_STRETCH: Deep pec / anterior-capsule stretch - fly, dip, deep bench
loadTags.SH_LOAD: General shoulder-joint loading - any press, row or pull
loadTags.ELB_EXT: Loaded elbow extension - triceps, all pressing
loadTags.ELB_FLEX: Loaded elbow flexion - biceps, all rowing and chinning
loadTags.ELB_WB: Weight-bearing through a locked elbow - push-up, dip, plank
loadTags.HIP_DEEPFLEX: Deep hip flexion - below-parallel squat, deep lunge
loadTags.ADD_STRETCH: Adductor lengthening under load - wide stance, lateral lunge
loadTags.HF_LOAD: Active hip-flexor loading - leg raise, knee raise, sit-up
loadTags.KNEE_LOAD: Loaded knee flexion-extension - any squat, lunge or press
loadTags.KNEE_DEEP: Deep knee flexion under load - below parallel, deficit, sissy
loadTags.KNEE_OPEN: Open-chain knee extension - leg extension, sissy, reverse nordic
loadTags.HAM_STRETCH: Hamstring under stretch or eccentric load - RDL, nordic, good morning

copy.Caution tooltip: This exercise loads the area indirectly ({reason}). Keep the load light, stay inside a pain-free range, and stop the set if the pain increases.
copy.Side-only tooltip: Train the {side} side only for this exercise until the {pain} settles. Training one side still keeps a good part of the strength on the other side.
copy.Priority tooltip: This is corrective work for your {pain}. Do it at the start of the session while you are fresh.
copy.Removed - list header: {n} exercises were removed from your program because of: {pains}
copy.Slot rerouted: We could not train {subregion} safely with your {pain}, so that slot went to {replacement}.
copy.Session shortened: This session is {n} exercises instead of {m}. With your {pain} there was nothing safe left to put in the last slot.
copy.Medical disclaimer: DEEP FIT adjusts your program around pain you report - it does not diagnose or treat it. If the pain is severe, came on suddenly, followed an injury, or is getting worse, see a clinician before you train.
copy.Re-check prompt: Still feeling the {pain}? You can untick it any time and the program rebuilds instantly.
